entries.german: schenkt dem Ulrich v. Rosenberg die Barg Veliš, die Burg Brada, die Städte Jičin, Bydzov u. Veselé, die Burg Lipnic, die. nach dem Tode des Čenek v. Wartenberg heimgefallen sind. KU?
entries.english: grants Ulrich von Rosenberg the castle of Veliš, the castle of Brada, the towns of Jičin, Bydzov, and Veselé, and the castle of Lipnic, which had reverted to him after the death of Čenek von Wartenberg. Charter?
